description: This file defines a helper object for importing and exporting GLM classification models in Spark MLlib, including methods for saving and loading model metadata and data.

classes.name: GLMClassificationModel
classes.description: Helper object for import/export of GLM classification models, containing nested object SaveLoadV1_0.

methods.name: thisFormatVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string for the model format, '1.0'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves model metadata and data to specified path, including model class, number of features, classes, weights, intercept, and threshold.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads model data from specified path, returning weights, intercept, and threshold.
